problem_before.description: Problem before this pull request: the local trigger and what was wrong or missing.

change.description: The intended correction this pull request makes.

example_before_after.description: A short concrete example of behaviour before and after.

items.description: One step: a line range of one file, normally at the head commit.

id.description: Step id, unique within this output; used by edges and references.

title.description: Short title, also the diagram label.

file.description: Repository-relative path on the step's side.

side.description:
head normally; base only for removed code with no head line to anchor to (deleted or emptied file,
removed block); kind is then deleted_site and the lines are base lines. `head`: Lines of the head commit. `base`: Lines of the base commit (removed code).

start_line.description: First line of the step on its side.

end_line.description: Last line of the step on its side.

kind.description: Step kind. `modified`: Logic changed in place. `added`: New code. `moved`: Block moved from elsewhere. `renamed`: Identifier rename only. `deleted_site`: Code removed here. `context`: Unchanged code connecting the flow.

moved_from.description: Original location of a moved block, or null.

file.description: Repository-relative path at the base commit.

decides.description: What this step decides or changes.

why.description: Why this step or modification is needed.

annotations.description: Annotations anchored to lines inside the step.

items.description: An annotation anchored to lines inside a step (same side as the step); the annotated range is highlighted.

type.description: Annotation type. `behaviour`: Behaviour change, was → is. `consequence`: A consequence of the change. `question`: A question for the reviewer to check (also LLM suspicions). `note`: Any other remark.

basis.description: fact needs evidence lines you read; anything else is inference. `fact`: Read in the code; needs at least one evidence line. `inference`: Not directly read; a conclusion.

was.description: Behaviour of these lines before this pull request (hover tooltip; facts only, no risk or verdict).

is.description: Behaviour of these lines after this pull request (hover tooltip; facts only, no risk or verdict).

text.description: The consequence, question or note; null for a behaviour annotation (its content is was and is).

evidence.description: Lines read that support the annotation.

items.description: A line the agent actually read and cites as evidence.

side.description: head for the checked-out code; base only for removed code read from the base commit. `head`: Lines of the head commit. `base`: Lines of the base commit (removed code).

assessment.description: Required assessment of the change, including low risk; nullable only when reading older stored output.

headline.description: What a production user or operator would notice.

risk.description: Risk band from the severity skill; never its numeric scores. `low`: Small or contained effect. `medium`: Noticeable in some situations or by some users. `high`: A production user or operator would clearly notice.

reason.description: Reason for the band, also for low.

basis_note.description: What was read and that nothing was executed.

origin.description: Introduced by this pull request or pre-existing. `introduced`: Introduced by this pull request. `pre_existing`: Existed before this pull request. `unclear`: Cannot be told from what was read.

blocking.description: Whether an action is proposed before merge, as a follow-up, or neither. `no_action_proposed`: No blocking action or follow-up proposed; this is not an assurance of safety. `blocks_this_pr`: Should be resolved before this pull request merges. `follow_up`: Can be handled in a follow-up.

steps.description: Steps in reading order following control flow; every changed line of the flow lies inside a step.

items.description: A graph edge between two steps.

label.description: Label for decision outcomes, loop back-edges and error exits; null otherwise.

edges.description: Graph edges between steps in execution order.

items.description: Code outside the diff that the change may affect; its location (head lines) is its evidence.

step_id.description: Id of the step whose change reaches this code.

file.description: Repository-relative path at the head commit.

reason.description: Why this code may be affected.

basis.description: fact if read in the code, otherwise inference. `fact`: Read in the code; needs at least one evidence line. `inference`: Not directly read; a conclusion.

impact_refs.description: Code outside the diff that this change may affect.

items.description: A pattern applied in several places, explained once in a step.

explained_in_step_id.description: Id of the step that explains it.

sites.description: The other places where it is applied.

items.description: One place where a repeated pattern is applied.

side.description: head normally; base for a removed site. `head`: Lines of the head commit. `base`: Lines of the base commit (removed code).

pattern_repetitions.description: Patterns applied in several places, explained once.

items.description: The status of a listed GitHub review thread.

thread_alias.description: Thread alias from the thread list: t1, t2, ….

status.description: Status against the current code. `still_valid`: The thread still applies to the current code. `stale`: The thread refers to code that no longer exists here. `already_addressed`: The current code already addresses the thread.

thread_statuses.description: Status of every listed GitHub thread located in this flow's steps.
